config.crosshair-enhancements.title: ${mod_name} Settings
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.thi: Renders the crosshair while you're in third person mode.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.spe: Renders the crosshair while you're in spectator mode.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.deb: Renders the 3D crosshair instead of a vanilla one.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.cro: Toggles crosshair blending. Disable it to see actual crosshair colors.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.ind: Toggles indicator blending. Disable it to see actual indicator colors.
Toggles the full indicator rendering for player hand & other non-weapon items. Also fixes visual glitches with an indicator while having non-vanilla attack speed attribute.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.res: Renders the full indicator as soon as you can land a full-charged hit. Minecraft's minimum charge threshold is 90%.
config.crosshair-enhancements.option.att: Changes where the attack indicator is displayed.
